scope: Independent static review of exactly four source changes; not an installation, end-to-end or 24x7 acceptance.

checks.finding: Primary protected config remains first choice. Only missing/denied/unreadable errors allow the fixed LOCALAPPDATA fallback. Handoff requires schemaVersion1, exactly four keys, host127.0.0.1, integer port1..65535 and a 32-hex secret. Invalid readable primary or fallback fails closed.

realpath/lstat checks occur before open; the opened file is bounded/plain/single-link and size/mtime/link count are rechecked. This does NOT verify Windows owner/DACL or atomically pin checked parent/leaf identity. A check-to-open replacement race remains if another principal can write those paths.
checks.classification: deployment prerequisite and explicit reader limitation
checks.currentDeploymentDisposition: Not a material blocker for the specifically attested protected parent and ordinary-user consumer. Trust is supplied by external ACL creation, not by this Node reader; no elevation or cross-user authority is introduced.
checks.requiredAssumption: Root attests parent inheritance disabled with only concrete UserSID/SYSTEM/Admins, file created after parent protection, and Relay runs ordinary per-user. This reviewer did not inspect credential or live ACL.

checks.finding: New output uses fixed reason whitelist; Rust warning logs only that reason. Telegram secret is not included in changed logs or command argv. Secret buffers are zeroed in read/connection finally paths; error causes are not serialized. Bootstrap bridge token remains in private IPC URL as existing design, not added to these warnings.
checks.classification: changed code reviewed; no runtime privacy scan claimed

checks.finding: Recovery relaunches only OwnedWorker using original token and exact port/URL; replacement must report the same ready URL. Backoff1/2/4/8s is capped, resets after30s stable lifetime, and stop channel breaks recovery. Existing job-bound cleanup retained. alive denotes supervisor/endpoint ownership and may remain true while endpoint is being recovered; ready does not prove Lagom route health.
checks.classification: source lifecycle verified; no runtime recovery measurement

checks.finding: Each fresh socket attempt rereads config, retries only config-unavailable/denied/listener-unavailable, clears secret buffers, and destroys failed candidate. At most10 attempts with250ms wait and1200ms socket deadline remain subordinate to existing12s handshake deadline; worst-case does not guarantee all10 attempts. No public route or service management added.

Cold --start-hidden suppresses configured/main visibility and focus; repeated hidden launch returns before foregrounding. Explicit ordinary second-instance launch retains direct window.show/unminimize/set_focus. This source check does not validate all tray/deeplink behaviors or actual desktop launch.
checks.classification: source startup behavior verified within scope

checks.finding: One best-effort X then Instagram prewarm pair follows observer registration, only when not locked/inactive, with unmount checks and per-command catch. Existing native activation APIs and switch queue are unchanged. Individual command failure is logged but not automatically retried by this once-per-mount prewarm; actual social load success is outside this review.

interopProjectionLimits: The handoff is a fixed four-field projection, not a synchronization service. Source rereads it for each new TCP connection but never updates it from Lagom.
Normal Lagom readConfig/writeConfig/start/stop key preservation is context supplied by Root, not independently audited in these four Relay files.

If key or port is manually changed outside this projection while protected primary stays unreadable, an authorized writer must refresh the handoff. Retrying stale handoff values cannot fix key mismatch; existing TCP sessions are not transparently migrated.
No actual installer, TG payload forwarding, native social view load or long-running stability was exercised by this reviewer.

feedback.applyMeaning: Accept or question this bounded review finding; does not execute installation, modify services or change credentials.
